listen_addr.description: IP address for the proxy to listen on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

backend_name.description: Name identifying this proxy instance’s backend group

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed

transparent.description: Enable transparent proxy mode (typically used when proxy sits in-line on the network path)

proxy_protocol.description: Enable PROXY protocol to preserve client IP when proxying through another proxy

timeout_connect.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing connection to backend servers

timeout_server.description: Timeout (seconds) waiting for response from backend servers

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs (debug, info, notice, warning, error)

log_file.description: Path to the log file (if not specified, logs to stdout)

backend_servers.description: List of backend servers to proxy requests to

name.description: Unique name for this backend server (e.g., 'web1')

address.description: IP address or hostname of backend server

weight.description: Relative weight for load balancing (higher = more requests)

backup.description: Mark as backup server (only used when all non-backup servers fail)

check.description: Enable health checks against this backend

max_connections.description: Max concurrent connections allowed to this backend

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS on a separate listener

ssl_listen_addr.description: IP address for SSL listener (ignored unless ssl_enabled)

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file

ssl_ciphers.description: Colon- or space-separated list of allowed SSL ciphers (fallback to defaults if omitted)

ssl_prefer_server_ciphers.description: Prefer server cipher order over client order during TLS handshake

acl_rules.description: Access control rules for routing or blocking traffic

pattern.description: Regex pattern or prefix used to match request path or host

rate_limits.description: Per-ACL or per-group rate limiting rules

name.description: Name of the rate limit (must match an ACL rule or 'default')

window.description: Time window in seconds over which to measure requests
